observations.body: Jesus speaks of glorification, a new command to love one another, departure where disciples cannot yet follow, and Peter’s claim that he will lay down his life before three denials.
observations.label: After Judas leaves, glory, love, departure, and denial are spoken

observations.body: The passage presents Loving, departing, following, and laying down life as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: Loving, departing, following, and laying down life

observations.body: The passage places When Judas had gone out beside Loving, departing, following, and laying down life.
observations.label: When Judas had gone out

payload.posture: Read John 13:31–38 as one movement in the Last Supper, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: Peter’s promise and Jesus’ denial prediction
payload.title: After Judas leaves, glory, love, departure, and denial are spoken
